published_title: Lingrell's Rebel Strike Team   2nd Place RCon Open
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''CRingwell''') posted a [[Light]] [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: Using hand manipulation, 3 types of retrieval, lots of direct damage, and good drains...beat on the opponent.  This deck went 9-0 during the DPC (played by lolli) and the Open (played by me)
cards: posted: Do or Do Not/Wise Advice
notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 13 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed, Endor, Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest), Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Strike Planning; they count toward the 60. The strategy says 'You start strike planning', so it is the starting Effect.

The title and sign-off say the poster finished 2nd (runner-up) at the RamapoCon 3 Open, going 5-0 on Saturday including the final duel against Hayes Hunter. The description says the deck went 9-0 across 'the DPC (played by lolli)' and the Open; an edit says Lolli placed 5th in the DPC with it. The DPC is not named.
'Purple' is a section header (it heads Deactivate The Shield Generator and I Did It!) and was removed. Total 60 as published.

Posted 'Endor' dested the Light Endor-set system Endor (Light), which the objective deploys; 'Gen Solo' dested General Solo; 'Jedi Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'EPP Luke/Obi/Leia' dested Luke With Lightsaber, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Haash'n' dested Major Haash'n; 'Ackbar' dested Admiral Ackbar; 'Midge' dested Corporal Midge; 'Blount' dested Lieutenant Blount; 'Cracken' dested Colonel Cracken; 'Crix Madine' dested General Crix Madine; 'R2 in Red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Out of Commision' dested Out Of Commission; 'Do or Do Not/Wise Advice' dested Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice; 'Back Door' and 'Bunker' dested Endor: Back Door and Endor: Bunker.
